references.text: Shaaraim is also mentioned in connection with the Israelites' pursuit of the Philistines after David defeated Goliath, which shows the city's strategic location.
Gederotaim and other cities from Judah's inheritance are mentioned within the settlement areas of the tribe of Simeon.
Gedera and Gederotaim are mentioned in connection with the Philistines' attacks on the cities in the lowland during King Ahaz's time.
This verse is part of the list of cities in Judah's lowland, and verse 32 mentions the total number of cities in this region.
Gederot is also mentioned in this region, a city with a name similar to Gedera and Gederotaim in verse 36.
